rejected.source: Flexmaster; Westaflex; Hydro-Temp; Hamilton; Southwark; Advantage Air Dynaflex/Whispaflex sheets; Polyaire 2016 catalogue
rejected.title: Checked, no usable flexible-duct capacity table
rejected.reason: Flexmaster and Advantage Air product sheets give only rated maximum velocity (20 m/s, 4000-5500 fpm), which is a structural rating, not a design figure. The Westaflex 2015 catalogue, the Polyaire 2016 R-value sheets and the AA Dynaflex/Whispaflex sheets have no sizing data. The Hydro-Temp, Hamilton and Southwark tables are for round sheet metal, not flex. Not found online: Advantage Air SA.CAT 2014 PDF, the ActronAir Aires guide, Daikin/Mitsubishi/Fujitsu/Temperzone flex tables, the ADC Flexible Duct Performance & Installation Standards (paid), ACCA Manual D 3rd edition (paid), and the TAFE NSW 'Sizing flexible ductwork' toolbox page (host gone, not archived).
